svg.aria-label: About Apheleia — a creative studio for what’s next. Apheleia (ἀφέλεια) is the Greek spirit of simplicity. Founded by seven friends in Tamil Nadu, India in 2026: designers, engineers and strategists building digital products that feel effortless, and the systems that keep them that way at scale.

g.text: Apheleia — ἀφέλεια — is the Greek spirit of simplicity.
Founded by seven friends in Tamil Nadu, we’re designers,
engineers and strategists building digital products that feel
effortless, and the systems that keep them that way at scale.
